Home.MetaDescription: Information about Ayane and a showcase of my projects.
Home.HeroText:
I'm a high school student and programmer, born in 2010.
I wish I could live my life as a cat.
I enjoy exploring all sorts of things, not just programming.
I'm still a bit of a novice, so please go easy on me!

About.IntroText:
I'm a 16-year-old high school student and programmer.
I like to take things at a relaxed, easygoing pace.
I dabble in all sorts of things beyond just programming.
I'm a bit fragile, so please treat me with kindness!
Lately, I haven't had many chances to code—yikes!
